title: hWin window face wired (GATED): formal/RhAttack/S4WinCap.lean certifies the window floor cap and the face identity - on the WHOLE window band 1000 <= t, 0 < d < 1/200 the unified S2 floor floStripMin is STRICTLY BELOW a single S4 wire term (floor = own mass mown < 31/(10^5 t^2), and that cap is below the P8 tail term at the wire index on both branches: near t <= 110000 by the squaring chain to 50000^2 t^4, far t > 110000 by 62t < 100000 t^2), so hWinFace (the hWin hypothesis of RHEnd.rh_program78 over the Z78P12 aliases) is EQUIVALENT to zero-exclusion of off-line zeros on [1000, inf) x (0, 1/200). The squeeze instrument is certified NOT to reach the window band; the face is the zero-exclusion statement there. Measured backstop (s35a survey): margin floStripMin - (Bwire + Mr) < 0 at every surveyed point on t in [1e3..3e10] x d in (1e-9, 1/200), floor = 4d^2/t^2 to relative 2e-13, Xwire(110000) = 1.827275e-3 <= RX, 25m total at T0 = 0.936536 < 0.9975. 98 cards; full tree green (17450 jobs)
body: FORMAL MILESTONE (no RH claim): the hWin residual of the endpoint is now CHARACTERIZED - the window squeeze is proven to be the wrong instrument on the window band, and the face is named as the zero-exclusion statement the band actually requires.  MODULE:  formal/RhAttack/S4WinCap.lean (namespace S4WC; imports Mathlib + the pinned dependency closure B0/B4/B5/B3Core/S4Asm/S4Window/S4Growth/S4Own/S1LowT/Z78P12/P8Floor/FloorUnif; build green; full tree re-verified at 17450 jobs, 0 errors; 0 sorry).  THREE CONTENTS:  (1) poffOwnMown - at the pair's OWN HEIGHT (gamma = t) the B5 off-line factor product has mass exactly S4O.mown t d: B5's four canonical factors at (t, d, t) are exactly the 8-factor S4Own kernel (z1..z4 via the rhoPP/rhoPM/rhoNP/rhoNM = z1..z4 identification chain, closed by dsimp + Complex.ext + simp/ring, with halfR = (2:R)^-1 = 1/2 as the bridging numeral), and S4O.hMownProd is the 25n closed-form bridge.  (2) floorBelowWire - the window floor cap, proven on the WHOLE band 1000 <= t, 0 < d < 1/200:  floStripMin t d <= |poff| t d t = mown t d [min/max structure of floStripMin + poffOwnMown];  mown t d < 31/(10^5 t^2) [mownWindowScale: each own-kernel factor pinned SEPARATELY and then multiplied - 4d^2 < 1/10000 from d < 1/200 (cross-multiplied), 1 + 1/(16 t^2) <= 16000001/16000000 (one_div_le_one_div + nlinarith on the exact identity), exp(1/t^2) <= 1/(1 - 1/t^2) <= 1000000/999999 (the log x <= x - 1 pin with t^2 >= 10^6); the strict-inequality discipline matches every mul_lt_mul_of_pos_{left,right} call to the goal's literal factor parse];  and 31/(10^5 t^2) is STRICTLY below the p8_B(t, n) tail term at the wire index on BOTH branches:  near (t <= S4W.T0 = 110000) via nearTailBelowScale - the squaring chain 12493 t/8 < 12493 t^4/8 < 2e9 t^4 <= 2.5e9 t^4 = 50000^2 t^4 (all explicit mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left/right and mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left with the positivity haves made explicit; the wire index floor(13 t/8) is <= the t^2 scale via S4W.hpow1 and Nat.floor_le);  far (t > T0) via farTailBelowScale - 62 t < 100000 t^2 by div_lt_div_iff0 cross-multiplication (31 t / 50000 < t^2, i.e. 31 t < 50000 t^2, at t > 110000), with the wire index floor(t^2) below the t^2 scale again by floor_le.  hXgrowPos carries the far branch: S4G.Xgrow t > 0 for t > T0 (every factor positive; Sbar > 0 by the S4W.hLn27 ln-pin with 27 <= t^2).  (3) THE FACE IDENTITY - def hWinFace (z) restates the hWin hypothesis of RHEnd.rh_program78 VERBATIM over the Z78P12 wire aliases (BwireP/MrP/MfP of Z78P12 == S4A.BwireR/MrR/MfR on the band), and two theorems close the equivalence:  hwinFaceImpliesZeroExclusion (a zero set holding the face has NO off-line zero in [1000, inf) x (0, 1/200):  the endpoint's own squeeze gives wire + Mr + Mf < floor while floorBelowWire gives floor < wire, with Mr >= 0 (hMrgen, branched on t <= T0 with S4W.hXwire_pos / hXgrowPos) and Mf = 0, so wire < wire + Mr + Mf < wire - contradiction by lt_irrefl of the additive form) and zeroExclusionImpliesFace (vacuous direction).  MEASURED BACKSTOP (survey s35a, tmp/s35a_hwin_far_survey.py, log tmp/s35a_hwin_survey.log, re-implementing the Lean pins in Python and reproducing them BEFORE taking results):  the margin floStripMin - (Bwire + Mr) is NEGATIVE at every surveyed point on t in [1e3 .. 3e10] x d in (1e-9, 1/200) (logarithmic grids); the floor equals the own-kernel scale 4 d^2/t^2 to RELATIVE 2e-13; Xwire(110000) = 1.827275e-3 reproduces the pinned RX = 0.00185 regime (strictly below); the 25m total at T0 = 0.936536 sits strictly below the p8_f_near_pin = 0.9975 closure.  THE FACE REMAINS OPEN:  it asserts zero-exclusion of off-line zeros on a band NO INSTRUMENT in the tree reaches (classical zero-free regions give Re > 1 - c/ln t, which is nowhere near 1/2 - 1/200 at any of the surveyed heights) - the Lean module proves the instrument's IRRELEVANCE on the band, not the zero-exclusion.  ENDPOINT RELATION:  RHEnd.rh_program78 is UNAFFECTED - the four named residuals (hs1, hs3, hWin, hS2low) are untouched; hWin is now CHARACTERIZED (a zero-exclusion statement with a certified-inadequate squeeze), not closed.  CARDS:  98 cards / 804 body lines (new card formal/cards/S4WinCap.md); _MAP.md carries the S4WinCap block in the S4-squeeze section and the hWin line in the endpoint block now points at it; PATHWAY-TO-A-SOLUTION.md carries the GATED paragraph after the B7 formal block.  NEXT LEVER:  the face is a zero-exclusion claim on [1000, inf) x (0, 1/200) - its discharge route is an imported zero-free-region result (or a walk/certification over the band), i.e. classical-analytic territory, and it is the only h-family named residual whose Lean-side preparation (the characterizing identity) is now complete.
